title: Uninitialized thumbnail handle can cause use-after-free or double free
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not specified for this finding)
summary: When an image already fit within a requested thumbnail box, the API returned success without setting the output handle. Callers such as heif-enc and the C++ wrapper could release an uninitialized or stale pointer, causing use-after-free or double free.
ai_role: The item-level libheif advisory explicitly attributes discovery to Anthropic's OSS Scanner as ANT-2026-F9U9FFM3. The release notes independently state that all listed security issues were found by the scanner. The Anthropic program sources establish model-based scanning, but no per-case model is identified.
classification_note: The primary advisory establishes a publicly disclosed security finding and direct Anthropic OSS Scanner attribution. No CVE had been assigned in the libheif release notes at the checked time; the distinct GHSA is used. No exploitation or zero-day status is asserted.
remediation_note: The no-thumbnail path returns an empty image and initializes the C API handle to null; in-tree callers also initialize handles. Fixed in libheif 1.23.7. The libheif v1.23.7 security release is dated 2026-10-26; deployed patch status is not checked.
